shape: Vite + React SPA, react-router with a <Layout> wrapper route. No server of any kind.
whyThisShape: The pure-client case. There is no schema, no queue, no HTTP route and no background job, so every prompt written against a full-stack repo has to degrade rather than invent. Its domain also lives in an external API (PokeAPI), which tests whether the prose can name a domain it cannot read the source of.
labeledFrom: Read src/App.tsx (nested router config) and listed src/pages/; domain nouns taken from src/pages/ and src/types/.
